Definition: {(for man or beast), especially bread, or grain (for making it)}
BiblicalUsage: lᵉchem means bread, and once is enough to see what it is doing. In Daniel 5:1, "Belshazzar the king made a great feast to a thousand of his lords".
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Belshazzar's feast is the warning — a thousand lords eating and drinking while the writing was on the wall.
